shared_elements: low-relief carving on a weathered pale stone slab
row of repeated rectangular raised compartments (upper zone)
profile heads/creature forms rendered in shallow relief
rounded, softly modelled raised outlines against a recessed ground
justification: Both are shallow relief on pale weathered stone and both organise their upper field into a horizontal register of repeated rectangular units above a lower zone, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a dense, uniform grid of small, intricately curvilinear framed blocks covering the whole slab, while B is sparse, with a few large simplified animal-like figures at very different scales on a tall in-situ pillar.
